verdict.rationale: Apple documents strong battery-life claims (up to 22-24 hours) and power efficiency for M4 Pro MacBook Pro models, but M4 Pro ships only in premium Pro laptops/desktops (MacBook Pro, Mac mini, Mac Studio) with fans, not in fanless designs — those use base M4. Community commentary questions the efficiency marketing comparisons but doesn't concretely disprove the battery claims. missing for 10: fanless product examples, independent/hands-on battery-life verification beyond Apple's own figures.
